prescribed_diagnosis: The patient presents with symptoms indicative of Carpal Tunnel Syndrome, primarily affecting the wrist and forearm. To address this, the rehabilitation circuit targets the primary complaint (Protocol 8: Carpal Tunnel Wrist & Forearm Extension) by improving wrist and forearm mobility and strength. This is synergistically supported by Protocol 4 (Post-Fracture Elbow Flexion Rehab) to enhance elbow and forearm kinetic chain function, crucial for proximal stability during distal tasks. The circuit is anchored by Protocol 3 (Cervical & Ergonomic Posture Guard) to address the axial postural component, recognizing that poor cervical and thoracic posture can exacerbate upper extremity nerve compression and muscle imbalances, thereby promoting a comprehensive kinetic chain approach.

exercises_performed.protocol_name: P8: Carpal Tunnel Wrist & Forearm Extension (Seated)
